rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something having little physical width, such as a hallway or road.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 zau2 long4 hou2 zaak3

rows.note: Use this for a narrow escape or a result decided by a very small margin, emphasizing how close or risky it was.

example.english: It was a narrow escape this time; we nearly lost to our opponents.
example.traditional: 今次真係險，差啲輸畀對手。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 him2 caa1 di1 syu1 bei2 deoi3 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a restrictive or inflexible interpretation, viewpoint, or policy.

example.english: His way of thinking is too narrow to accommodate new ideas.
example.traditional: 佢嘅諗法太狹隘，容唔落新觀念。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 nam2 faat3 taai3 haap6 aai3 jung4 m4 lok6 san1 gun1 nim6

rows.note: Use this written adjective for something confined to a small extent or compass rather than physically narrow.

example.english: This policy has a very narrow scope.
example.traditional: 呢個政策嘅適用範圍甚隘。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 ge3 sik1 jung6 faan6 wai4 sam6 aai3
